words.def: a structured, regular plan of exercise followed over time
words.ex: He followed a strict outdoor fitness {regime} every week.

words.def: the ability to keep doing something physically demanding for a long time
words.ex: Running long distances builds your {stamina} over time.

words.def: a day with no exercise so your body can recover
words.ex: Most trainers recommend at least one {rest day} per week.

words.def: to control your speed or effort so you don't get tired too quickly
words.ex: It's important to {pace yourself} on a long hike.

words.def: to maintain the same speed or level as someone else
words.ex: I found it hard to {keep up} with the group on the hill.

words.def: able to follow a plan reliably without giving up
words.ex: Being {disciplined} about your workouts leads to real long-term progress.

words.def: slowly but without stopping, at an even pace
words.ex: Her fitness improved {steadily} over the summer.

words.def: to make yourself work harder than feels comfortable
words.ex: You need to {push yourself} a little each time to see results.
